notes: The author's answer names the activity — a simple exploration game where players walk around a bright, natural forested roadside — and that is an environment built to be explored rather than won, which is Entertainment. I checked Adventure first because 'exploration' sits in its recognise-from column, but its own boundary rule sends this case away: there is no focal pull, nothing to collect, no gate and no reveal, so it is a showcase rather than an adventure. Free-Roam Showcase on world-open matches 'walk around' better than the genre's default guided route, since nothing here sequences the visitor through a prescribed order. I kept the preset's hero build and curated first reveal but dropped its hidden badges, because collectibles would add an objective the author explicitly did not ask for, and I treated the roped street lights as the hero subject to compose the map around — they are the one specific thing the prompt insists on, standing along a road through dense trees.
